column1: # Named events -> live-state topics (docs/PLAN-live-interface.md step 13, D12). Columns, tab separated: kind, topics (comma list of topics of
# scripts/lib/live-topics.tsv), how, note. how = `log` (the kind is also written to the event log: it must be in scripts/lib/event-kinds.tsv) or

# `refresh` (a name for a refresh only: it must NOT be in event-kinds.tsv, so the log keeps only real events). A script, a watcher or a hook says `live_refresh event:<kind>` (scripts/lib/live.sh); the same word works for
# `hs sys live refresh` and for the collector. Only the topics listed are read again; the broad groups (`@instances`, `@disks`, ...) stay as aliases
# for one release. A kind the table does not list wakes the group `@system` (a wrong refresh is
# cheap, a missed one is what a page notices). Checked by tests/event-topics.sh. Every topic keeps its interval as the safety net.

column4: a container or VM appeared
an instance started
an instance stopped
an instance was removed
a disk was plugged in (disk-event.sh)
a disk was pulled (disk-event.sh)
a share was created, deleted, restored, purged, snapped, cached or its permissions or size changed (the share scripts)
a disk was detached or recovered (disk-detach.sh, disk-recover.sh)
a pool was created, changed or removed (manage-pool.sh)
a pool was imported (pool-import.sh)
a temporary disk was added or removed (temp-disk.sh)
the disk health check ran (disk-health.sh)
the state database saw a disk (state.sh scan)
the daily SMART check ran (state.sh)
the disk inventory was collected again (state.sh collect)
the health check ran (health-check.sh)
a job unit was stopped by hand (jobs.sh stop; the topics of the group @jobs)
a package was fetched, installed, removed, updated or a repository changed (pkg.sh)
upsmon reported a UPS event (ups.sh event)
a vault was created, opened, closed, moved or removed (vault.sh)
a Docker container or image changed (the Docker watcher of the collector)
